snippet.title: Into the Depths - Updated Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3705150/Into_The_Depths/?utm_source=youtube

Published an updated demo for Into the Depths a few weeks ago.

The changes since the last version include:
- A reworked expansion system
- Improved deckbuilding
- New cards
- Occasional random events
- Minor quality-of-life changes and visual improvements

Into the Depths is a roguelite city builder set in a mysterious underground world where every action matters.

#indiegame #roguelite #citybuilder #deckbuilder
